intro: Information governance is how you handle people's personal data legally, securely and ethically to protect their dignity, privacy and trust.
points: Report any suspected data breach immediately; the ICO must be told within 72 hours when people's rights are at risk.
Treat health and care details as special category data, which needs extra protection and both a lawful basis and an extra condition.
Only access confidential information on a need-to-know basis; curiosity is never a good enough reason to look.
Follow the seven data protection principles: use information lawfully, fairly, accurately and only for the purpose it was collected.
Recognise a subject access request, even when made verbally, and pass it to your manager to answer within one month.
Share without consent to keep someone safe: for safeguarding, a medical emergency, or a legal duty; never stay silent on risk.
